thread:
claire: hey team — eu-embed is spiking mem and returning intermittent 502s. traced to recent quant change in v2.4.3. need a hotfix and a fast approval to push a rollback + patch in the midnight change window (00:30 UTC).
deploybot: Deploy check triggered for release: redwood/eu-embed:v2.4.2-hotfix1 (candidate) — canary ready. CI: green, e2e: flaky on one test but unrelated.
claire: summary: pin to v2.4.2, revert quant flags, apply small mem-tuning. rollback criteria: >3% 5m error or tail latency >2s for 5m.
mike: +1 on urgency. we should also add a short changelog entry and note the rollback command.
sofia: can approve but need SRE ack on failover and scaling policy. @opsbot can you confirm capacity if canary fails and we shift traffic back?
opsbot: Capacity check: eu pool has spare nodes (2x buffer). Automated traffic shift policy available. Manual failover steps documented.
alex: quick question — will we need database migrations?
claire: nope, no schema changes. purely inference runtime config and image swap.
mike: OK — i approve for midnight window. +1 from me.
sofia: +1 from me as well, but want deploy notes included in thread.
claire: notes to attach for release: 1) reason: memory regression from quant change. 2) action: deploy redwood/eu-embed:v2.4.2-hotfix1 3) rollback: redeploy v2.4.2 stable; command:```kubectl -n eu rollout restart deploy/eu-embed --image=redwood/eu-embed:v2.4.2``` 4) monitor: latency, 5xx, mem RSS per pod 5) notify #incidents if rollback triggers.
deploybot: Scheduled deploy for 2025-05-14T00:30:00Z. Canary percentage: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 10m steps. Auto-rollback disabled (manual gate).
claire: manual gate because we want human check on perf regressions. @sofia @mike please be on call for 00:25–01:00 UTC.
sofia: i'll be available. setting calendar block.
mike: i'll standby. adding quick smoke test: ```curl -sS https://eu-embed/api/health | jq .status``` — expect "ok" and rss < 1.2GB per pod.
opsbot: Reminder: add release note in /releases/notes/ and update internal changelog.
claire: done — added notes link: https://intranet/releases/6491012345-hotfix-eu-embed. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
